about.title: About Chula Vista Elementary School District
about.content: Chula Vista Elementary School District serves elementary students and families in Chula Vista and the South Bay area of San Diego County. The district school year-round calendar is the main planning source for student start and end dates, fall break, Thanksgiving Week Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, minimum days, teacher prep days, parent/teacher conferences, legal holidays, and declared holidays. Families searching for a Chula Vista elementary school calendar often use this page to compare official dates, minimum-day windows, and district breaks before checking campus-specific schedules.

about.title: How to Use This CVESD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide CVESD school-year planning, then confirm campus-specific events, bell schedules, conference details, emergency closures, same-day announcements, and school-site reminders through CVESD or your child's school.

customSections.label: CVESD Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: CVESD serves TK-6 elementary students in Chula Vista, California. CVESD calendar planning is especially important for South Bay elementary families because the district uses a school year-round calendar with an early July start, fall break, winter break, spring break, and many scheduled minimum days. Families comparing CVESD with Sweetwater UHSD or other San Diego County calendars should note that elementary and secondary calendar patterns may differ. Review the official PDF closely when arranging childcare, transportation, conferences, and after-school programs.

planningTips.title: CVESD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the official school year-round calendar PDF for districtwide student dates, breaks, holidays, minimum days, and teacher prep days.
Plan childcare around minimum days and parent/teacher conference windows because dismissal schedules may differ from regular school days.
Check school-site communications for bell schedules, program-specific events, and same-day announcements.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

districtFaqs.q: Is the CVESD calendar a year-round school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The official CVESD PDFs are labeled as School Year-Round Calendars and list 180 school days, breaks, minimum days, and teacher prep days.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify CVESD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official CVESD school calendars page and school-site announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Chula Vista Elementary School District.
